state.goal: Continue background SUNNY reconstruction between turns, with source forensics as one parallel stream rather than the whole creative scientific mission.
state.authorized_bound: 256 actual model requests across initial unattended24h lease, persistent across restart, max128 useful atomic cases; no artificial delay or unlimited spending. Each single case uses selection plus source assessment, no pointless joint assessment.
state.native_scope: Historical native role=user/assistant sources only, all duplicate refs retained, exact full-message projections/hash/role/time; no current generated tool/hook/task feedback.
state.remaining_backlog: All eligible records preserved. Queue a finite deduplicated subset now; remainder pending for future authorized batches.

initial_batch.instructions: Choose the useful initial finite background source-forensics batch from real eligible counts. This is operational coverage scheduling, not evidence weighting or a confidence score.

criteria.balanced128: Queue128 atomic historical source cases balanced round-robin across bridge-use/control, calendar/epoch/reform, and symbol/phonetic mapping. Actual Jev chooses each next case, stopping before persisted256-request ceiling; remaining cases stay pending.
criteria.balanced96: Queue96 balanced atomic cases, preserving more request budget for later targeted pairs or exact probes.
criteria.balanced48: Queue48 balanced atomic cases as a smaller first intake, retaining the full remaining manifest.
